name: Nguyen Thi Mai Linh
headline: Senior Project Manager | Agile & Scrum Delivery Leader
summary: Senior Project Manager with 9 years of experience leading cross-functional teams in software delivery and digital transformation projects across fintech and e-commerce sectors. Skilled in Agile and Scrum methodologies, stakeholder management, and driving projects from initiation through successful delivery. Proven track record of managing distributed teams and aligning business objectives with technical execution.

responsibilities: Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise software projects for banking clients
Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups
Manage stakeholder expectations across product, engineering, and client teams
Oversee project budgets and resource allocation for teams of up to 25 members
Coach junior project managers and scrum masters on Agile best practices
Managed Scrum teams delivering e-commerce platform features
Coordinated with product owners to prioritize backlog items
Tracked project milestones and reported progress to senior leadership
Facilitated cross-team dependencies between development and QA units
Assisted senior project managers in planning and scheduling software projects
Prepared status reports and meeting minutes for stakeholders
Supported onboarding of new team members and process documentation
Monitored project risks and escalated issues as needed
